text:
Noah: Who's up for a quick "vertical sprints" challenge at 12:10 today? 4 rounds, 5 routes each, rest 90s. Fast, not heavy. :timer_clock: :muscle:
Rina: Oof that sounds nasty but I like it. Can we do easier feet-only warmups first? My calves are still sore.
Devon: Count me in. Suggestion: start on V0-V2 for the first two rounds, then V3 for the last two. Keep rotations of 2 so belays are quick.
Noah: Good call. Meetup at the boulder wall lobby. Bring chalk. I'll put a post-it with route orders.
ClimbBot: Reminder posted: "Vertical sprints @12:10 - lobby" :bell: (auto)
Rina: If anyone wants to film a slow-mo dyno for IG I can take a clip. Also whoever finishes earliest owes a round of cold brew? :wink:
Devon: Deal. See you there!
